description.fun: Oranguru is a wise old orangutan that meditates high in the treetops, carrying a fan woven from leaves and its own fur. It feeds hungry Pokémon, gives medicine to injured ones and can even use human tools, Poké Balls included. Ancient people mistook Oranguru for humans and called them the 'people of the forest', and it sometimes heads to the beach to match wits with Slowking.
description.guide: Oranguru is a Normal- and Psychic-type Pokémon from Alola based on an orangutan and a guru. It is intelligent and solitary, helping other Pokémon and even using human tools. It is a counterpart to Passimian, and each appears in different game versions.
description.tagline: A wise forest sage that likes to give orders
